items.title: Bulls on Parade: Physical Natural Gas Prices March Higher
items.summary: Looming weather-driven consumption, strong export demand and softer output sustained upward momentum across much of the natural gas spot market on Tuesday.

items.title: Short-Covering Rally Extends Winning Ways for Natural Gas Futures
items.summary: Natural gas futures advanced again on Tuesday after a surge in short covering propelled the front month into rally mode.

items.title: More Natural Gas, Less Cold Send EIA Winter Price Forecast Tumbling
items.summary: Despite surging LNG exports, the Energy Information Administration (EIA) slashed its winter natural gas price forecast, citing unusually mild weather, rising storage expectations and production growth that continues to outpace demand.

items.title: European Council Splits with Parliament in Vote for Shorter Delay of Methane Rule for LNG Importers
items.summary: The European Council has voted to delay significant methane reporting regulations for fossil fuel importers by just one year in a split with the European Union’s (EU) other legislative body.

items.title: Venture Global Targets July CP2 Startup as Gulf Coast Natural Gas Demand Grows
items.summary: Venture Global has advanced its target for first LNG production at its CP2 project to July 2027, bringing forward another source of US feedgas demand as it prepares to sanction expansions at two Gulf Coast terminals.

items.title: LNG Canada Maintenance Puts Western Canadian Natural Gas Demand in Focus
items.summary: LNG Canada has scheduled maintenance involving both liquefaction trains through early December, potentially curbing Western Canadian natural gas demand after several months of steady LNG exports.

items.title: TC Energy Leverages Mexico Pipeline Network to Capture Rising Natural Gas Demand
items.summary: TC Energy is focusing on small-scale laterals and last-mile infrastructure in Mexico to support the power sector, using its existing asset base to meet growing energy demand.
